Dynamic Power on the Horizon!

Feel the power of the shifting winds, and brace for an epic storm as mighty Dragon-type Pokémon make their triumphant return! Rayquaza VMAX leads the surge from on high, and Duraludon VMAX towers above the land in its Gigantamax form, joined by Dragonite V, Noivern V, and more. As the clouds part, Eevee’s Evolutions appear in a full rainbow of Pokémon V and Pokémon VMAX to signal a bright new day in Pokémon TCG: Sword & Shield—Evolving Skies!



THE POKÉMON TCG: SWORD & SHIELD — EVOLVING SKIES ELITE TRAINER BOX includes:

• 1 competition-legal coin-flip die

• 2 acrylic condition markers

• A collector’s box to hold everything, with 4 dividers to keep it organized

Introducing Pokémon V-UNION: a single powerful Pokémon divided into four cards! When you rise
to the challenge and put it all together (with the help of Professor Burnet), each fantastic Pokémon
V-UNION brings four amazing attacks into battle at your side. Find more treasures in Pokémon TCG
booster packs, and prepare to unleash a Pokémon V-UNION!



Each Pokémon TCG: Mewtwo V-UNION Special Collection includes:

• 4 promo cards that make up a single Pokémon V-UNION for Mewtwo V-UNION!

• 1 oversize card featuring the star Pokémon V-UNION

• 1 helpful Supporter card featuring Professor Burnet

• 4 Pokémon TCG booster packs

• A code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online


(Pokemon TCG booster packs vary by product.)

Each Sword & Shield - Evolving Skies Elite Trainer Box Pokemon Center Exclusive Case contains 4 boxes.


Each Pokémon Sword & Shield - Evolving Skies Elite Trainer Box Pokemon Center Exclusive includes:

• 10 Pokémon TCG: Sword & Shield—Evolving Skies booster packs

• 1 special collector's pin featuring Eevee

• 65 card sleeves featuring Eevee’s Evolutions—Glaceon, Vaporeon, Sylveon, & Espeon

• 45 Pokémon TCG Energy cards

• A player’s guide

• A Pokémon TCG rulebook

• 6 damage-counter dice

• 1 competition-legal coin-flip die

• 1 metallic Pokémon coin featuring Vaporeon, Espeon, Glaceon, and Sylveon

• 2 acrylic condition markers

• A collector’s box to hold everything, with 4 dividers to keep it organized

• A code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online
